title: 특허법ㆍ실용신안법ㆍ의장법ㆍ상표법의시행에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Cases Remanded to the Patent Court)
(1) Where a case involving a petition for an appellate trial or immediate appeal against a trial decision or decision dismissing a petition for trial is remanded to the Patent Court and a judgment revoking the trial decision or dismissal decision becomes final, the Intellectual Property Tribunal shall rehear the case and render a trial decision or other decision.
(2) The grounds forming the basis for the revocation in a judgment under paragraph (1) shall bind the Intellectual Property Tribunal in the relevant case.
